lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 vertical white stripes are visible across the lateral torso; spacing is relatively uniform through the mid-section and becomes more compressed towards the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior stripe is truncated and does not reach the dorsal ridge. Several posterior stripes terminate abruptly before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A primary cluster of 4 high-contrast spots is visible on the upper mid-flank. A secondary grouping of 2 spots is located lower on the posterior haunch near the tail base.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the mid-flank are aligned in a near-horizontal linear formation.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, projecting dorsoposteriorly from the skull before curving medially and anteriorly at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 2.5 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on approximately the distal 12% of the overall horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible markers include a white V-shaped chevron between the eyes, two white spots on the lower cheek, a white dorsal mane, and tan-colored lower limbs.
